v.description: Schema version. Future versions must increment this integer.

videoId.description: Video identifier used as the DynamoDB sort key.

bucket.description: S3 bucket that stores the original and output objects.

originalKey.description: S3 object key for the original uploaded asset.

renditions.description: List of rendition identifiers the worker must produce (e.g. 240p, 360p, 480p).

submittedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the job was enqueued.
